about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: Frontend engineer and product builder with a long-standing passion for creating digital experiences that are fast, clear, and intuitive. I started coding in 2001 and have built my career around modern JavaScript ecosystems, with deep expertise in React and React Native.
about.paragraph2: After working as a Frontend Developer at InterCloud, I moved into entrepreneurship and am currently building two initiatives: Vue d'Esprit, a digital studio delivering web and product solutions, and Kaast, a media communication platform designed for internal company collaboration and engagement, already used by multiple clients.
about.paragraph3: My work has expanded toward full-stack development, including Node.js services, API design, infrastructure setup, and Docker-based deployments. I work with SQL/PostgreSQL databases and tools such as Prisma and Sequelize to build scalable and maintainable systems. My earlier experience at Apple in technical support and product testing shaped a practical, detail-oriented approach focused on usability, reliability, and real-world impact.

about.paragraph4: For the past two years, I have also served as President of the kids nonprofit association Le Sou des Ecoles de La Bâtie Montgascon. We organize 7 events each school year, helping generate a budget of over €900 per classroom to support school trips and other activities for the children.

synqit.title: Founder & Product Engineer
synqit.summary: Collaborative playlist platform for events and cross-service sharing between Spotify and Apple Music through a single magic link.
synqit.point1: Led end-to-end product design and development, from the web app to mobile-first guest pages, with Spotify and Apple Music API integrations.
synqit.point2: Built the event playlist flow with no-signup guest submissions, live host moderation, event closing, and guest-link management.
synqit.point3: Designed cross-platform playlist sharing that lets users import a playlist from one streaming service into another with a simple, reliable experience.
